findings.reason: The workflow name is rendered as 'Sprite Sheet Üretici' in the title, metaDescription and howToUse but left as 'Sprite Sheet Generator' here; inconsistent naming within the same page.

findings.span: idle, attack, walk ve jump sekansları
findings.suggestion: bekleme, saldırı, yürüme ve zıplama sekansları
findings.reason: The same animation names are translated in the description ('bekleme, saldırı, yürüme ve zıplama') but left in English here, creating inconsistency across the page.
'image' is rendered as 'görsel' throughout the description, metaDescription, howToUse and FAQ, but as 'görüntü' in the extendedDescription; the term should be consistent across the entry.

findings.span: Mobil uygulamalar için animasyonlu diziler geliştirmek.
findings.suggestion: Mobil uygulamalar için animasyon sekansları geliştirmek.
findings.reason: 'diziler' reads as 'series/arrays' in Turkish; 'sequences' in this animation context is better rendered as 'sekans'.

Register inconsistency across the page: the description and the FAQ answers use the informal imperative ("yükle", "gir", "azalt", "kullan"), while howToUse switches to the formal plural ("yükleyin", "yapılandırın", "ekleyin"). The page should use one consistent address form.

findings.suggestion: bir görsel oluştur (or render both occurrences consistently)
findings.reason: Within one sentence 'image' is rendered twice differently: 'stil referans görseli' vs 'bir görüntü'. The term for 'image' should be consistent across the entry.
Omits 'to run the graph' from the source, and 'Execute' should follow the UI term 'Yürüt'.
'kimlik talimatları' is unidiomatic; the source says 'credential instructions', i.e. 'kimlik bilgisi talimatları'.
'Girdi' is capitalized mid-sentence although the source uses lowercase 'inputs' as common noun, not a UI label.

findings.suggestion: daha sonraki referanslar detaylarda ince ayar yapabilir
findings.reason: Literal rendering of 'nudge details'; 'detayları itmek' reads oddly in Turkish.

findings.span: birleşik art direction ile ürün hero görselleri
findings.suggestion: bütünleşik sanat yönetimiyle ürün tanıtım görselleri
findings.reason: English terms 'art direction' and 'hero' are left untranslated without being proper nouns, making the sentence read as code-switched text.
'mood' is left in English although a natural Turkish equivalent exists; also inconsistent with the otherwise translated sentence.

findings.span: Seedance 2.0 - Extend Video, bir giriş klibini
findings.suggestion: Seedance 2.0 - Videoyu Uzat, bir giriş klibini
findings.reason: The workflow name is left in English here while the page title translates it as 'Videoyu Uzat'; the two fields are read together and should be consistent.
'batch' is rendered three different ways across the entry ('grup', 'parti', 'dizi'); 'parti' is also unnatural Turkish for a frame batch. Glossary maps batch → toplu.

findings.span: Üretilen kareler yeni ses içermez, genellikle orijinal parça kesime kadar korunur
findings.suggestion: Üretilen kareler yeni ses içermediğinden, genellikle orijinal parçayı kesime kadar korursunuz
findings.reason: Comma splice joining two independent clauses; a native writer would use a causal subordinate clause. The English also addresses the user ('you'll typically preserve'), which is lost in the impersonal passive.

findings.span: Uzattıkça kalite ve sahne tutarlılığı azalabilir
findings.suggestion: Uzattıkça kalite ve sahne tutarlılığı genellikle azalır
findings.reason: English states this generally does decrease; 'azalabilir' (may decrease) weakens the claim.

"Talent casting" is rendered as "Oyuncu Seçimi" in the title and use cases but as "yetenek seçimi" here; inconsistent terminology within the same page (and "yetenek" literally means 'ability' in Turkish).
"Talent" (performer) translated as "yetenek" (ability), inconsistent with "Oyuncu" used in the title and use cases.
Improper mid-sentence capitalization; glossary casing applied where a normal lowercase adjective is required.
Improper mid-sentence capitalization of a common noun.

findings.span: bu da yetenek seçimi, sunum dosyaları ve erken müşteri onayı için uygun hale getirir
findings.suggestion: bu da onu yetenek/oyuncu seçimi, sunum dosyaları ve erken müşteri onayı için uygun hale getirir
findings.reason: Missing object pronoun makes the clause grammatically incomplete in Turkish.
Turkish vowel harmony: the accusative suffix after 'LoRA' (back vowel) should be '-yı', not '-yi'. Same error recurs in 'LoRA’yi video kareleri boyunca'.

findings.span: İş akışını ComfyUI içinde aç ve gerekli düğümlerin mevcut olduğunu doğrula
findings.suggestion: İş akışını ComfyUI içinde açın ve gerekli düğümlerin mevcut olduğunu doğrulayın
findings.reason: Register inconsistency within the page: description and metaDescription use the formal/plural imperative ('yükleyin', 'işleyin'), while howToUse and FAQ switch to the informal singular ('aç', 'koy', 'seç').
'hat' alone is an unnatural rendering of 'pipeline'; also the mid-sentence capitalization of 'Boyama' is incorrect in Turkish.

findings.span: LTX 2.3 LoRA Boyama uygulayan özel işlem düğümünü aç
findings.suggestion: LTX 2.3 LoRA boyama uygulayan özel işlem düğümünü aç
findings.reason: 'Boyama' is capitalized mid-sentence without reason; Turkish does not capitalize common nouns here.

findings.span: kare kare boyama yaparak kaldırır ve LoRA ile güçlendirilmiş bir difüzyon geçişi uygular
findings.suggestion: LoRA ile güçlendirilmiş bir difüzyon geçişiyle kare kare boyama yaparak kaldırır
findings.reason: The English states the inpainting is performed with the LoRA-enhanced diffusion pass; the translation splits it into two separate actions.

findings.span: yeniden yapımı inandırıcı içeriğe doğru yönlendirirken
findings.suggestion: yeniden oluşturmayı inandırıcı içeriğe doğru yönlendirirken
findings.reason: 'yeniden yapım' normally means 'remake' and is an unnatural rendering of 'reconstruction' in this technical context.

The glossary requires 'image' → 'görüntü'; the entry consistently uses 'görsel' instead, which diverges from the ComfyUI app terminology (affects description, metaDescription, extendedDescription, howToUse, use cases and FAQ).
Glossary requires 'adjustments' → 'ayarlar'.
Glossary requires 'image' → 'görüntü'; 'görsel' is used instead.

findings.span: Bu, tüm varyasyonlar için temel görseliniz olur.
findings.suggestion: Bu, tüm varyasyonlar için temel görüntünüz olur.
findings.reason: Glossary requires 'image' → 'görüntü'; 'görsel' is used instead.
'dizi' means array/series; the correct Turkish term for 'string' is 'dize', which the same text uses later ('ön ayar dizelerini'), creating internal inconsistency.
'dizi' (array) used instead of 'dize' (string), inconsistent with other occurrences in the entry.

findings.suggestion: akışın önceki aşamalarında hazırlanan girdileri kullanan
findings.reason: 'upstream' is rendered as 'at the input', losing the meaning of earlier nodes in the graph; 'inputs' is also rendered as 'parametreler'.

findings.span: ilgili uzantıyı yükleyin ve tekrar açın
findings.suggestion: ilgili uzantıyı yükleyin ve yeniden yükleyin
findings.reason: 'reload' is translated as 'open again', which is not the same instruction.
Title left entirely in English while the rest of the page is translated; 'Image Edit' should follow the glossary (image → görüntü).
Product-UI term 'Queue Prompt' must be rendered as 'İstemi Kuyruğa Al' per the required glossary.
'aç' means to lighten a color, which contradicts 'koyu mavi' (deep blue); the English 'brighten the jacket to deep blue' is mistranslated into a self-contradictory phrase.

findings.span: talimatı yalnızca seçili alanla sınırlı tut
findings.suggestion: talimatı spesifik tut, böylece seçimin dışındaki istenmeyen değişiklikler en aza iner
findings.reason: English says keep the instruction 'specific' to minimize changes outside the selection; translation instead says to limit the instruction to the selected area, shifting the meaning.
Inconsistent rendering of 'image' within the same sentence (görüntü vs görsel); glossary requires image → görüntü.
'image-edit' is a descriptive English phrase, not a protected proper noun, and should be translated per glossary (image → görüntü).
